## What problem does this solve?

Describe the gap or limitation you're running into. What can't you do today?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to see added or changed. Be as specific as you can — if it involves a new Notion property, include the property name and type. If it involves a new AI engine, note any known rate limits or login requirements.

## Which part of the pipeline does this affect?

- [ ] Research stage (`research-analyst`, `website-geo-auditor`)
- [ ] Tracking stage (`brand-geo-monitor`, `run-engine.js`)
- [ ] Strategy stage (`geo-intelligence-synthesizer`)
- [ ] Content stage (`content-creator`, `content-reviewer`)
- [ ] Notion schema / databases
- [ ] BigQuery / analytics
- [ ] Setup / tooling
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Alternatives you've considered

Are there simpler approaches or workarounds you've tried?

## Additional context

Any examples, links, or screenshots that help explain the request.
